column1: # B1162 continuation (ruling 01:50Z, ONE leg): Intimidation -> Fear 229
# (record 13 skull cloud) through the client's REAL ability path.
# Step 1 (offline, README "Continuation step 1"): `uVar5 == 0x47` in the one
# OP_InstillDoubt (0x389e) sender is NOT a key code: uVar5 is the SKILL ID the
# ability function FUN_0041f4a0 is called with (0x47 = 71 = Intimidation). Its
# four callers all read a skill id out of the Actions-window ability slots
# ([Abilities] AbilityN / [CombatSkills] CombatSkillN of the character INI):
# /doability N (0x46a813), the Abilities-page button (0x4d3b9d), the Combat-page
# button (0x4d3f73) and a hotbutton (0x514241). The caster's INI had every slot
# at -1 (attempt 2 before-character.ini) and /doability on a -1 slot returns
# silently (0x46a7fb). And the client's own class/level skill table (.data
# 0x698b30) gives Intimidation to classes 7 MNK (lvl 18), 8 BRD (26), 9 ROG (22),
# 16 BER (1) -- NOT class 1 Warrior, so a Warrior's ability call returns before
# any packet. Attempt 2's G press and Warrior class could never send it.
# This leg: class 9 Rogue, level 60, skill 71 = 5000 before zone-in (pre-SQL),
# ability slot 1 = 71 in the caster's character INI for this leg only (restored
# byte-identically at stop), TrollF000 targeted + #stun, caster standing, then
# `/doability 1` twice (10 s client reuse, 9 s server reuse in between).
# HARD RULE: zero C->S OP_InstillDoubt => record the finding and fall back to the
# ONE allowed GM leg (b1162_fear229_gm.tsv); no block.
